name: bean-book
description: Untappd for coffee beans and tea — static, offline PWAs (Bean Book & Leaf Book) built from GitHub Issues.

scripts.build: npm run build:coffee && npm run build:tea
scripts.build:coffee: node scripts/build-data.js coffee && node scripts/build-site.js coffee
scripts.build:tea: node scripts/build-data.js tea && node scripts/build-site.js tea
scripts.start:coffee: npm run build:coffee && node scripts/serve.js coffee
scripts.start:tea: npm run build:tea && node scripts/serve.js tea
